evidence.notes: Local no-render selector contract accepts a context Id and returns no default template.
Legacy alias follows the same local no-render selector contract.

source.content: @isTest private class CoreRuntimeSupportEmailTemplateSelectorEvidenceTest { @isTest static void selectorRows() { Support.EmailTemplateSelector selector = new Support.EmailTemplateSelector(); System.assertEquals(null, selector.getDefaultEmailTemplateId((Id)'001000000000001AAA')); System.assertEquals(null, selector.getDefaultTemplateId((Id)'001000000000001AAA')); } }
